title: Set up WZXU
text: Right-click WZXU-Document-Reader-Portable.zip and choose Extract All. Open the extracted WZXU Document Reader folder. Double-click WZXU Document Reader.exe. Keep _internal and libreoffice beside the EXE. Free, offline, no account, for Windows.

title: Open a document
text: Click Open document, press Ctrl+O, or drag a supported file into the window. Office previews can take a moment. One document at a time; a new file replaces it.

title: What you can open
text: PDF: .pdf. Word: .docx and .doc. Excel: .xlsx and .xls. PowerPoint: .pptx and .ppt. Text: .txt. Images: PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP, TIFF, BMP. Also ODT, ODS, ODP and RTF. Office previews may vary. Slides are static. Spreadsheets use print layout; images have no OCR.

title: Find your page
text: Scroll to read continuously. Click a thumbnail to jump to a page. Use Previous / Next or Alt+Left / Alt+Right. Type a page number and press Enter. Click Thumbnails to hide or show the sidebar.

title: Make it easy to read
text: Fit width uses the available reading width. Fit page shows a complete page. Choose a percentage for fixed zoom. Click + or - to adjust the size. Shortcuts: Ctrl+= / Ctrl+-. Select Fit width again to restore automatic fitting.

title: Search the document
text: Press Ctrl+F or click the search field. Type a word or phrase. Press Enter, F3, or Find next. Repeat to cycle through matches. Delete the query to clear highlights. Search needs real text; scans require OCR elsewhere.

title: Copy page text
text: Navigate to the page you want and check the current page number. Click Copy page text. Paste into Notepad or Word with Ctrl+V. Copies the whole current page as plain text. No mouse passage selection; images need OCR.

title: Everyday controls
text:
Print: File > Print or Ctrl+P. Choose a printer and page range.

Rotate: File > Rotate current page clockwise or Ctrl+R. Temporary 90-degree rotation.

Recent documents: File > Recent documents reopens a recent file.

Resume reading: Preferences > Resume at last page remembers your position.

Privacy: Preferences > Remember recent documents controls local history. No uploads.

Close or cancel: Close document or Ctrl+W clears the view or cancels opening.

Opening problems: Keep libreoffice beside the EXE. Office files must be unprotected; PDFs can prompt for a password.

Your original stays safe: Reading and rotation do not change the source. No editing or OCR.
